title: Great Indian Peninsula Railway Company, Statement of Receipts and Working Expenses, Revenue Account, 18 April 1853 to 31 December 1857
version: Company secretary’s signed printed return reproduced in the House of Commons Select Committee on Indian Railways report
lineage: Company return printed in the 1858 parliamentary appendix. The retained scan image is from the Library of Congress copy distributed by Internet Archive.

passages.locator: Appendix No. 1, printed p. 292 (scan page 318), statement signed 15 June 1858
passages.note: The signed company revenue account begins its first period on 18 April 1853 and closes it on 30 June 1854, recording receipts, working expenses and net profits paid to the East India Company against interest advanced.

file.method: Poppler pdfseparate per requested page, then pdfunite in the listed order.
